title: ALX Verification Context
description: Validation context passed to graph verification operations. Declares the validation mode, graph root, and any external parent boundaries.
$comment: This schema validates context shape only. It does not itself authorize open-world validation, prove Graph validity, or define mixed-version compatibility semantics.

protocolVersion.description: ALX Protocol version. Must be '1' for v1.

validationMode.description: Validation mode: closed-world requires all parentHashes to resolve; open-world permits declared external boundaries.

graphRoot.description: blockHash of the Block at the root of the graph being verified.

extensions.description: Extension identifiers active during this verification run.

hash.description: blockHash of the external parent being declared.

reason.description: Boundary classification: external-boundary (outside this system), private-boundary (access-restricted), unavailable-boundary (temporarily unavailable), unknown-boundary (classification unknown).

declaredBy.description: Source of this boundary declaration. Always 'verification-context' for context-declared boundaries.

requiredForFullValidation.description: True if resolving this parent would be required for a complete closed-world verification.

externalParents.description: Parent hashes explicitly declared as external boundaries. Permits open-world verification without treating these as missing parents.
